name: Deramon
text: ＜Blocker＞ (This Digimon can block in the blocker timing.)[On Deletion] You may play 1 Digimon card with [Avian], [Bird], [Vegetation] or [Plant] in any of its traits and 3000 DP or less from your hand without paying the cost.(Rule) Trait: Has [Vegetation] Type.

name: GrandGalemon
text: [On Play][When Digivolving] Suspend 1 Digimon. If this effect suspended your Digimon, you may play 1 Digimon card with [Avian] or [Bird] in any of its traits and 3000 DP or less from your hand without paying the cost.
[Your Turn] [Once Per Turn] When this Digimon attacks your opponent's Digimon, this Digimon may unsuspend.

text: ＜Vortex＞ (At the end of your turn, this Digimon may attack an opponent's Digimon. With this effect, it can attack the turn it was played.)[When Digivolving] Suspend 1 Digimon.
